ai_model_architectures.fish_tracking: ByteTrack (Ultralytics) on YOLO11-seg detections + phase-correlation camera-motion compensation
ai_model_architectures.water_telemetry: Water Quality Index from preset station values
ai_model_architectures.impact_fusion: XGBoost Regressor (160 estimators) trained on synthetic data
ai_model_architectures.biodiversity_loss: XGBoost Regressor (140 estimators) trained on synthetic data
ai_model_architectures.explainable_ai: SHAP (TreeExplainer) + Grad-CAM on YOLO11-seg neck layers

data_provenance.plastic_detection: REAL - YOLO11-seg trained on TrashCan 1.0, run on real test images
data_provenance.plastic_detector_quality: Weak - trash_plastic precision ~0.37, recall ~0.31 on leak-free images (see HANDOFF.md)
data_provenance.fish_behavior: REAL, SMALL SAMPLE - ByteTrack over test video frames with camera-motion compensation; few mobile animals are tracked, so plastic-related behaviour change cannot be concluded
data_provenance.coral_health: NOT ASSESSED for TrashCan (deep-sea ROV footage, no reef). For other photos: colour/texture heuristic with a coral-presence check; a trained SUIM coral model is pending
data_provenance.water_temperature_and_bleaching_alert: REAL - NOAA Coral Reef Watch 5km daily satellite SST, Degree Heating Weeks and Bleaching Alert Area at each station
data_provenance.ph_oxygen_salinity_turbidity: PRESET - station values (Copernicus Marine loader is implemented but needs a free account: `copernicusmarine login`)
data_provenance.station_assignment: ASSUMED - TrashCan images have no geotags, so images are assigned to stations in rotation
data_provenance.impact_score_and_biodiversity_loss: EXPERT FORMULA - XGBoost reproduces a documented hand-specified formula (synthetic training data); weights are assumptions, see src/modules/impact_scoring.py
data_provenance.shap: REAL - SHAP TreeExplainer on the XGBoost model (explains the model, which is trained on synthetic data)
data_provenance.gradcam: REAL - gradient-based Grad-CAM on the YOLO neck layers for the trash_plastic logit
data_provenance.geospatial_map: REAL station positions + NOAA CRW values; per-station scores average the images assigned to each station
